home.heroDesc: Learn German step by step with structured lessons, interactive exercises and AI-powered learning tools.
home.structuredLessonsDesc: Follow a clear learning path from A1.1 to B1 with topics, units and lessons designed to help you learn step by step.
home.interactiveExercisesDesc: Practice German through multiple choice, listening, typing, sentence-building and other interactive exercises.
home.aiLearningDesc: Practice German with AI-powered learning activities and conversation experiences.
home.aboutIntro: DeutschUp is a web-based German learning platform designed to make learning German simple, structured and engaging.
home.ourMissionDesc: Make German learning more accessible through structured lessons, interactive practice and modern learning technology.
home.pathSubtitle: Build your German skills step by step, from your first words to confident intermediate communication.
home.step1Desc: Sign up with your email or Google account.
home.step2Desc: Start with the German level that matches your learning journey.
home.step3Desc: Complete exercises, review vocabulary and follow your learning progress.
home.faq1A: DeutschUp is designed for learners who want to learn German from beginner to intermediate levels, starting from A1.1 and progressing toward B1.
home.faq2Q: HOW DOES THE LEARNING PATH WORK?
home.faq2A: Learning is organized into levels, topics, units and lessons. Each lesson contains vocabulary and interactive exercises to help you practice what you learn.
home.faq3Q: WHAT TYPES OF EXERCISES ARE AVAILABLE?
home.faq3A: DeutschUp includes multiple-choice, listening, typing, sentence-building and interactive wheel exercises.
home.faq4Q: CAN I TRACK MY LEARNING PROGRESS?
home.faq4A: Yes. Your learning progress and XP are recorded as you complete lessons and exercises, helping you monitor your journey.
home.faq5Q: CAN I LEARN GERMAN WITH AI?
home.faq5A: DeutschUp includes AI-powered learning features and a speaking practice room to give learners more opportunities to communicate in German.
home.faq6A: DeutschUp provides free learning content and premium plans with additional learning features.
